products.title: Car Diffusers – Long-Lasting Luxury Scents
products.description:
Elevate your driving experience with our premium car diffusers, designed to provide a continuous, refreshing fragrance. Each diffuser is crafted with high-quality fragrance oils in a diffuser base for a long-lasting scent that keeps your car smelling fresh and inviting!  

Available Scents:

Egyptian Cotton – A clean, crisp, and fresh aroma with soft floral and powdery undertones, evoking the feeling of freshly laundered linens.  
New Car Smell – The perfect blend of leather, plastic, and subtle musk, recreating that beloved "just bought" car scent.  
Plum & Rhubarb – A sweet and tangy fusion of ripe plums and tart rhubarb, creating a fruity and uplifting fragrance.  

How to Use
1. Unscrew the wooden lid and carefully remove the plastic stopper.  
2. Screw the lid back on securely.  
3. Tip the bottle upside down for a few seconds to allow the fragrance to absorb into the wooden lid.  
4. Hang the diffuser in your car and enjoy the scent.  
5. If the scent fades, simply tip the bottle again to refresh the fragrance.  

Our stylish and refillable car diffusers provide a subtle yet effective way to keep your car smelling amazing.

products.title: Vitamin E Nourishing Hand Cream, Lime & Coconut Scented
products.description:
My all-natural hand cream is the perfect addition to your skincare routine, offering a luxurious and nourishing treatment for your hands. Completely vegan-friendly and cruelty-free, this cream is formulated without parabens, sulphates, artificial fragrances, or colours, and is GMO-free. It’s a gentle yet powerful solution for dry, chapped, or sensitive skin, thanks to its rich Vitamin E content, which provides deep hydration and soothing relief. 

The addition of Vitamin E Oil adds antioxidants, helps lock in moisture while softening the skin, making it ideal for minimising the appearance of fine lines & wrinkles. For best results, apply it before bed to allow it to fully absorb into the skin overnight, leaving your hands feeling soft, nourished, and rejuvenated.

Scented with Lime Essential Oil and natural Coconut Oil.
